Original89 has a properly joined two-storey brick office and centred golden cupola. The dome crosses the owner seam without duplicate cells or missing ribs.
defects: Gold rib/finial silhouette and glazing highlights remain provisional against the native source.

notes: The source89 front paving and narrow planted strip retain their independent tile layer and native contact height.
defects: Planting colours and paving grain are less varied than the original source.

notes: Original90 retains its native near-wing offset, cornice, windows, colonnade and complementary cupola portion; Arctic and tropical live worlds are verified.
defects: The front colonnade reads too flat at native scale; detailed glazing/recess paint is not yet source-comparable.

notes: The source90 ground cut registers with the joined office rather than duplicating another tile's border or garden.
defects: Garden trim and source-scale stone/soil shadow detail need further comparison.

notes: Individually inspected in the joined original58/59 roof. Cupola is centred and partitioned without seam loss; finial and colonnade remain volumetric.
defects: Facade relief, glazing reflections and directional roof paint remain less source-detailed than the original.

notes: Independent original58 finished paving and planter retain their ownership and meet the connected body without a seam step.
defects: Paving/planting grain and source shadow detail require closer native-source matching.

notes: Original59 owns its half of the centred cupola and the actual shared entry arch; all four original finished-body construction slots are retained.
defects: Entry recess shading, stone courses and front-window paint still need source-scale refinement.

notes: Original59 paving completes the finished two-tile court; street review confirms slab contact and separate ground ownership.
defects: Tile-relative paving marks and fine source shadow/recess paint remain provisional.
